description: This file implements the TraceMiddleware class within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class is responsible for tracing and logging the state changes and HTTP request/response data between middlewares during AWS API calls. It includes features such as scrubbing sensitive information and formatting logs.

classes.name: TraceMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class for tracing AWS SDK requests, responses, and exceptions, with capabilities for redacting sensitive data and logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TraceMiddleware with configuration options and an optional AWS service object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Enables the middleware to be used as a callable, setting up the request/response tracing flow.

methods.name: stepInput
methods.description: Logs the entry into a middleware step with command and request data.

methods.name: stepOutput
methods.description: Logs the exit from a middleware step, including timing and results.

methods.name: compareStep
methods.description: Compares previous and current step data and logs the differences.

methods.name: commandArray
methods.description: Converts an AWS command object into an array for logging, including a redacted version of parameters.

methods.name: requestArray
methods.description: Converts a PSR-7 request object into an array for logging.

methods.name: responseArray
methods.description: Converts a PSR-7 response object into an array for logging.

methods.name: resultArray
methods.description: Converts an AWS result object into an array for logging.

methods.name: exceptionArray
methods.description: Converts an exception, particularly AwsException, into an array with detailed info.

methods.name: compareArray
methods.description: Recursively compares two arrays and records differences.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a scalar or exception.

methods.name: streamStr
methods.description: Returns a string for stream bodies, respecting size limitations.

methods.name: createHttpDebug
methods.description: Sets up debug streams in HTTP commands if enabled.

methods.name: flushHttpDebug
methods.description: Outputs the debug stream contents and cleans up.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Logs a string, optionally scrubbing sensitive data.

methods.name: redactHeaders
methods.description: Reduces headers by scrubbing sensitive header values.

methods.name: getRedactedArray
methods.description: Recursively redacts sensitive command parameters based on AWS shapes.
